# ToolsBoXMachine (TBXM)

> A collection of free, privacy-first browser tools for everyday tasks. No tracking, no accounts required.

TBXM is an open-source toolbox running entirely client-side. All processing happens in the browser — no data ever leaves your device.

## Tools

- [Blur Image](/tools/blur/blur.html) — Protect privacy by blurring sensitive parts of images
- [Calculator](/tools/calculator/calculator.html) — Perform basic arithmetic calculations
- [Text Corrector](/tools/correcteur/correcteur.html) — Fix grammar and spelling errors
- [Password Generator](/tools/password-gen/password-gen.html) — Generate secure passwords or passphrases
- [QR Code Generator](/tools/qr-gen/qr-gen.html) — Create custom QR codes for any link or text
- [JSON Formatter](/tools/json-formatter/json-formatter.html) — Format, minify, and validate JSON data
- [Base64 Converter](/tools/base64/base64.html) — Encode and decode Base64 strings
- [Pomodoro Timer](/tools/timer/timer.html) — Stay focused with timed work sessions
- [Emoji Keyboard](/tools/emoji-keyboard/emoji-keyboard.html) — Browse and copy emojis with one click
- [Notes](/tools/note/note.html) — Create, save, and manage notes

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

- [Tools Index (JSON)](/tools/index.json) — Full tool catalog with metadata
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml) — XML sitemap for crawlers
- [Robots.txt](/robots.txt) — Crawl rules and bot permissions
